Control.title and ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE carry the title through the segment model (control.py:161, segment.py:52).
Legacy Windows consoles receive the title via term.set_title (_windows_renderer.py:54-56). The reference does the same, so the feature covers the legacy Windows path as well.
The non-legacy path needs no special handling: Console.control buffers the segment text (console.py:1526-1528) and the escape is emitted as text.

Behaviour the reference also lacks, and that is not a regression: the title is not sanitized for embedded BEL or ESC characters. The generated code does not add this validation, and neither does the reference.
